title: Impact of switching between reference biologics and biosimilars of tumour necrosis factor inhibitors for rheumatoid arthritis: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.

answer.design_quote: Our NMA model provides six or three possible pairwise comparisons estimating the comparative efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity within and between switching and non-switching groups.
answer.k_quote: Seventeen randomized trials with a switching phase involving 6,562 patients were included.
